_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail because Waterfall (PaperMC's BungeeCord fork, the usual egg) is end of life: BungeeCord.jar from md_5's Jenkins (ci.md-5.net, now hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins), the last successful build or a build number. Jenkins publishes no checksum for the archived jar, so the install checks the build result, HTTPS and that the file is a BungeeCord jar. Tagged proxy (no server.properties or player tools, no eula flag: a proxy has no EULA prompt); a first config.yml with one listener so the panel sets its port; Java 25 to 17 images (BungeeCord needs Java 17); install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: BungeeCord
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: BungeeCord is md_5's Minecraft proxy: it links several Minecraft Java servers into one network. (Waterfall, PaperMC's fork, is end of life; use Velocity or BungeeCord.)

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# BungeeCord installation (Octail): BungeeCord.jar from md_5's Jenkins (ci.md-5.net, which redirects to
# hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins), the last successful build or a build number. Waterfall, PaperMC's fork, is
# end of life, so this egg installs BungeeCord itself.
# Jenkins publishes no checksum for the archived jar (its fingerprint list is for the Maven-deployed jar,
# which differs), so the build must be marked SUCCESS, the download comes over HTTPS and the file must be
# a jar holding BungeeCord's bootstrap class. A build that doesn't exist or failed fails the install.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

JOB=https://hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BungeeCord
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-bungeecord.jar}"
BUILD="${BUNGEE_BUILD:-latest}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${BUILD}" ] || [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
	BUILD=lastSuccessfulBuild
else
	case "${BUILD}" in
	*[!0-9]*) fail "the build number (${BUILD}) must be a number or latest" ;;
	esac
fi

INFO=$(get "${JOB}/${BUILD}/api/json?tree=number,result,artifacts%5BrelativePath%5D") ||
	fail "BungeeCord's Jenkins has no build ${BUILD}"
NUMBER=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.number // empty')
RESULT=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.result // empty')
[ -n "${NUMBER}" ] || fail "BungeeCord's Jenkins named no build number"
[ "${RESULT}" = "SUCCESS" ] || fail "BungeeCord build ${NUMBER} did not succeed (${RESULT}). Pick another build."
echo "${INFO}" | jq -e '.artifacts | any(.relativePath == "bootstrap/target/BungeeCord.jar")' >/dev/null ||
	fail "BungeeCord build ${NUMBER} has no BungeeCord.jar"

echo "Installing BungeeCord build ${NUMBER} as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "${JAR}.download" "${JOB}/${NUMBER}/artifact/bootstrap/target/BungeeCord.jar" ||
	fail "the download of BungeeCord build ${NUMBER} failed"
if ! unzip -l "${JAR}.download" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'net/md_5/bungee/Bootstrap.class'; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "the download of BungeeCord build ${NUMBER} isn't a BungeeCord jar"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

# A first config.yml with one listener, so the panel can set its port before the first start; BungeeCord
# fills in every other setting itself. An existing config.yml is kept.
if [ ! -f config.yml ]; then
	printf 'listeners:\n- host: 0.0.0.0:25577\n  query_port: 25577\n  query_enabled: false\n' >config.yml
fi

echo "BungeeCord build ${NUMBER} installed. Add your servers under servers: in config.yml."

variables.name: BungeeCord Build
variables.description: The BungeeCord build to install from ci.md-5.net, or latest for the last successful build. BungeeCord supports every current Minecraft version in one build.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the proxy jar file.
